notes: No breadboard is used; the circuit image shows the SCP1000 breakout wired directly to the Arduino header with seven hook-up wires.
The SCP1000 is powered from the Arduino 3.3V pin (not 5V), as the schematic shows.

DRDY goes to pin 6 and CSB to pin 7. The schematic draws these crossing, and the code agrees (dataReadyPin=6, chipSelectPin=7). The header comment in the code has them the other way round, so I followed the schematic and the code.
SPI lines: SCK to 13, MISO to 12, MOSI to 11.
Ground is taken from the GND pin on the Uno power header, which I recorded as GND.1.
The catalogue scp1000 entry has no separate pin for the unlabelled header positions, so I used only its listed ports.
